wrapper_autoround: extend an AutoRound instance with algorithm extension hooks for INT, MXFP, or NVFP quantization data types
quant_tensor_sym: quantize and dequantize a tensor using symmetric integer quantization with configurable bits and group size
quant_mx: quantize a tensor using mixed precision MXFP format with shared exponent and configurable mantissa rounding
iterative_wls_quant_search: perform iterative weighted least squares quantization search to find optimal scale and minimum values for GGUF formats
WrapperLinearV2: wrap a linear layer to enable weight quantization tuning with INT, MXFP, or NVFP data types
